# Aldea Blanca Rental

> Four-bedroom townhouse in Aldea Blanca, Nueva Andalucía, Marbella — the only home in the urbanisation with its own private heated pool. Sleeps 7, 180 m² interior on a 585 m² plot, walking distance to Puerto Banús. Booked through JustRent Marbella, not directly on this site.

This page describes one property. It has no other pages, no blog and no availability calendar of its own — current prices and dates live on the JustRent Marbella listing linked below.

## Key facts

- Location: Aldea Blanca, Nueva Andalucía, Marbella, Spain (29660). Coordinates 36.4897, -4.96301.
- 4 bedrooms (3 double, 1 single), 3 shower bathrooms, sleeps 7.
- 180 m² interior, 585 m² plot.
- Private heated pool (heating is a paid, on-request supplement — the pool itself is not heated by default).
- Rates: €271–€714 per night, VAT included, depending on season. Pool heating €50/night. Final cleaning €360/booking.
- Registered tourist accommodation: VUT/MA/88632.
- Distances: sandy beach 1.8 km, Golf Valley golf courses 3.6 km, Málaga Airport 63 km. Puerto Banús is walkable.
- House rules: families and couples only, no groups under 30, no hen or stag parties, non-smoking, no pets.
- Booking, pricing and availability are handled entirely by JustRent Marbella: https://www.justrentmarbella.com/rentals/terraced-house-nueva-andalucia-casa-blanca-mar-504092.html
